UPDATE users SET last_login_at=$1 WHERE (users.id = $2) AND (users.marked_as_deleted = $3)

INSERT INTO login_lockouts (email, failures, locked_until, last_touched) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4) ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET failures=CASE WHEN login_lockouts.locked_until > $5 THEN login_lockouts.failures ELSE (login_lockouts.failures + $6) END, last_touched=$7 RETURNING login_lockouts.failures, login_lockouts.locked_until
SELECT 1 FROM ONLY "public"."users" x WHERE "id" OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) $1 FOR KEY SHARE OF x

SELECT users.id, users."name", users.email, users.password_hash, users.marked_as_deleted, users.deactivated, users.password_changed_at, users.last_login_at, users.email_notifications_enabled, users.unique_id, users."language" FROM users WHERE (users.email = $1) AND (users.marked_as_deleted = $2)
